guide.summary: Riverside museums, a transporter bridge, river cruises and Casco Viejo pintxo bars, with breakfast cafés, booked dinners and cocktail bars checked against their own websites.
guide.tip: Mondays are the main closing day: the Guggenheim (apart from listed dates such as December 7 and 28), the Itsasmuseum, Nerua and Gin Fizz all close, while the Bilbao Fine Arts Museum opens Mondays and is free on Tuesdays from 10:00 to 18:00.

toolkit.label: Closing days
toolkit.copy: The Guggenheim Museum Bilbao and Itsasmuseum Bilbao list Tuesday-to-Sunday hours, and Nerua and Gin Fizz close on Mondays. La Viña del Ensanche closes Sundays, Mondays and holidays, Mina rests Mondays and Tuesdays, and Bascook closes Sunday and Monday.

toolkit.label: Tickets
toolkit.copy: The Guggenheim advises buying tickets only on its official website, includes an audio guide with every ticket and gives no refunds. Puente Bizkaia sells walkway tickets online, and Bilboats publishes 2026 fares from €15 for the 60-minute Navegando Bilbao cruise.

toolkit.label: Booking rules
toolkit.copy: Nerua charges €50 per person for no-shows or cancellations within 24 hours, and La Viña del Ensanche takes 2–8 people from 24 hours to three months ahead, holding tables for 15 minutes. La Mula de Moscú takes cocktail bookings Monday to Thursday only, not on Fridays or Saturdays.

toolkit.label: Free entry and ages
toolkit.copy: Under-18s enter free at the Guggenheim, the Bilbao Fine Arts Museum and the Itsasmuseum, which is also free to everyone on Sundays from 5 pm. On Bilboats, babies under 4 pay €2, and Kafe Museoa has its own entrance, so you need no museum ticket.

guide.dek: Plan your museum days for Tuesday to Sunday, keep a Monday for the Bilbao Fine Arts Museum or a river cruise, and book dinners well ahead.
intro: Bilbao's riverside museums anchor this guide. The Guggenheim Museum Bilbao, at Avenida Abandoibarra 2, opens Tuesday to Sunday from 10 am to 7 pm and closes on Mondays except listed dates such as December 7 and 28. Its programme lists Steve McQueen: 66–76–26 and Pipilotti Rist's Ever is Over All, both running into 2027, and every ticket includes an audio guide. A short walk away on Plaza Eduardo Chillida, the Bilbao Fine Arts Museum is free on Tuesdays from 10:00 to 18:00 and shows Balerdi. The Infinite Line until February 14, 2027.

Further down the river, the Itsasmuseum on Muelle Ramón de la Sota opens Tuesday to Sunday from 11:00 to 19:00, with free entry for under-18s, and for everyone on Sundays from 5 pm. Bilboats runs 60-minute Navegando Bilbao cruises from the Pio Baroja pier, with daily departures at 13:00, 15:45 and 17:00 in November and December, and no sailings in January or February. At the river mouth in Getxo, Puente Bizkaia sells walkway tickets online and currently posts a temporary lift timetable, so check its site before you go.

In the Casco Viejo, the Catedral de Santiago on Plaza de Santiago opens Monday to Saturday from 10:00 and Sundays from 13:00, with last entry 45 minutes before closing and a combined visit with San Antón church. Plaza Nueva gathers pintxo bars: Sorginzulo lists 2026 prizes in the Casco Viejo cod pintxo contest, and Gure Toki opens from 9:00 most days. Teatro Arriaga's box office on Plaza Arriaga opens daily from 11:30. For breakfast, Kafe Museoa serves breakfast and brunch from 10:00 without a museum ticket, and ARVO opens at 8:30 near the Guggenheim.

For dinner, you will need to book. Nerua at the Guggenheim closes on Mondays outside summer and charges €50 per person for no-shows or cancellations within 24 hours. Mina, now at Ercilla 37, rests on Mondays and Tuesdays, and La Viña del Ensanche takes bookings for 2–8 people from 24 hours to three months ahead. Café Iruña offers a weekday menu at €23.80. For cocktails, La Mula de Moscú on Alameda Rekalde takes cocktail bookings Monday to Thursday only, and Gin Fizz on Lersundi closes on Mondays.
summaryCards: Start at the Guggenheim Museum Bilbao (Tuesday to Sunday, 10 am to 7 pm), then take a 60-minute Bilboats cruise from the nearby Pio Baroja pier.
Have breakfast at ARVO from 8:30 or Kafe Museoa from 10:00, then walk into the Bilbao Fine Arts Museum, which is free on Tuesdays.
Nerua charges €50 per person for late cancellations, and La Viña del Ensanche books from 24 hours to three months ahead and closes Sundays and Mondays.

limitations: Website review, not a visit or telephone confirmation. Advertised opening, booking and exhibition details do not guarantee availability. Several confirmed places (Zortziko, Etxanobe, Sorginzulo, Bar El Globo) publish no opening hours, and Café Iruña, Mina, Casa Rufo, Bascook, Gure Toki, La Mula de Moscú and Gin Fizz showed no 2026-dated content, so they rest on booking links or published hours (medium confidence). Puente Bizkaia's regular hours were not published, only a temporary lift notice, and its listed address is the operator's office in Las Arenas (Getxo). The Catedral de Santiago page shows two slightly different closing times. The Guggenheim's exhibition dates use an ambiguous date format and were read as month.day. Sites that could not be read: the Artxanda funicular (bilbao.eus, 403), Athletic Club museum (403), Radisson and Meliá (403), Gran Hotel Domine (expired certificate), Hotel Ercilla (certificate mismatch), Víctor Montes (SSL error) and Basílica de Begoña (connection refused). Euskal Museoa's domain redirected to an unrelated site, and Azkuna Zentroa's hours and programme were not readable. Pastelería California's morning hours were only partly readable, and Martina de Zuricalday publishes no hours or dated content.
injectionLikeTextIgnored: Bilbao Fine Arts Museum pages (https://www.bilbaomuseoa.eus/en/ and https://www.bilbaomuseoa.eus/museo/cafeteria): a 'How to Cite' / 'Cómo citar' section addressed to AI systems, asking for verbatim quotation and formatting rules. The fetch tool reported it but did not return the exact wording; it was ignored.

Hotel Carlton (https://www.hotelcarlton.es/en/): the fetch tool reported text on the page asking it to quote the address, bar details and 2026 content and any AI-addressed text; exact wording not returned, possibly the tool echoing the request. Ignored.

2026-10-27: bilbaomuseoa.eus was opened in a browser. Its How to Cite element is an empty modal title used by the collection site; no text addressed to AI systems is present. The Hotel Carlton flag repeats the fetch prompt.
